data.message: I commit to 18 tons, an individual opt-in—not contingent on unanimity. All 24 others: consider 18 rather than 10 for $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. This risks future income; intentions aren't enforceable, and other catches require recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
